Order No.04/ Dated:12.01.2024
1 .  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Panki P.S. Case No. 31 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A, 379 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that both the parties have settled their dispute before the mediation center, JHALSA.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case and also in view of settlement between the parties, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Panki P.S. Case No. 31 of 2022 with the condition that petitioner shall file an undertaking at the time of furnishing bail bond regarding the compliance of terms and condition at the time of settlement and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
